result.summary: The screen is broadly functional, but several visual defects stand out: a badly formed discount badge ("-100%"), inconsistent favorite-button styling, text truncation without ellipsis in the horizontal carousel, an inconsistent card thumbnail, and a partially hidden card at the bottom edge.

issues.description: The promo badge on the pizza card reads "-100%", which implies the item is entirely free and is almost certainly a data/formatting error (or a discount value rendered without capping/labeling).
issues.suggestion: Cap discount values at a sensible maximum and label them clearly (e.g. "50% off" or "Free item"); validate the discount field before rendering.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different treatments: the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark/translucent circle with a white heart. Inconsistent affordance for the same control.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background, icon color and size across all cards, using a single semi-transparent scrim that works over any image.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is clipped by the bottom navigation bar — its image is cut mid-way and the name, rating and delivery info are not visible, making the list look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll container equal to the nav bar height so cards end cleanly, and avoid cutting a card at an arbitrary point in the viewport.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third restaurant name is hard-clipped as "Trattoria Piccol" with no ellipsis, and its card is sliced by the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis and size/peek the carousel items so a partial card is intentionally visible (consistent peek width) rather than arbitrarily cut.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the sibling thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually unbalanced; the white 15–25 min pill also has weak contrast on it.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (e.g. apply a consistent gradient/scrim) and ensure badge pills always have sufficient contrast against the underlying image.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off at the right edge with a sliver of a chip visible, giving no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a consistent right peek/fade edge or scroll indicator so it's obvious more categories exist.

issues.description: Secondary text such as the search placeholder, delivery prices and 'DELIVER TO' label is light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text colors to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart buttons) have no visible text label; if accessible names are missing they are unusable with screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels such as 'Notifications, 1 unread' and 'Add Tokumaru Ramen Bar to favorites'.
